test_case_specs.expected_result: 39 new tests: 37 failing (RED), 2 AC6 guards green by design; one pre-existing test changed on purpose and red until implemented
test_case_specs.notes: Assumed seams (all new, all injected): detectSetupScenario(root); buildSetupAgentPrompt(scenarioObject, {projectRoot, includeOptional}) with list lines '<cli> — <why>' and headings REQUIRED/OPTIONAL; SetupStep {cli, required, why, note}; renderSetupScenario prints [required]/[optional], reasons and the prompt; SetupModalOptions {projectRoot, copyText, showToast, externalAgents:[{id,name}], confirm(card:string[])=>Promise<boolean>, delegate({agentId,task,cwd}), runLine(prompt)}; button labels [Run], [Copy prompt], [Optional: off|on]; keys c/r/o. Only the first configured external agent is exercised; a multi-agent choice is not pinned. Pre-existing tests changed: setup-guide.test.ts 'refresh and repair preserve accepted content and start from a read' (first REQUIRED refresh step is `keryx update --skip-runtime --yes`; an optional update --preview now comes first); setup-modal.test.ts 'opens on the first scenario...' (reads the frame instead of visibleLines/SETUP_MODAL_KEYS, the hint now appears once) and the scroll test (frame-based, last line is the prompt's, renamed flow 468 AC9). The modal tests read the rendered frame and captureSpans, so visibleLines()/SETUP_MODAL_KEYS are no longer imported. The width test assumes pre-wrapped body text. The AC10 shell wiring is a source-text audit because tui-shell's launcher needs a real renderer, session and provider. Tests not committed; the orchestrator commits.

status_report.concerns: New tests reach unexported APIs through a namespace import and pass unknown options through a spread, so tsc stays quiet but they are red until phase B lands. Two AC6 guards (init default, explicit scenario wins) are green today by design.
